pin_verification.method: PyPI packument enumeration of stable releases only; immutable identity from git ls-remote refs/tags/<tag> with ^{} peel against the repository named in the package's own Homepage/url field, enumerating the FULL upstream tag namespace (48 tags, not a filtered subset); cross-checked against the GitHub releases API for draft/prerelease/published_at; declared dependency surface corroborated against upstream setup.py at the pinned commit; security qualification from the GitHub Advisory Database (ecosystem=pip) resolved per admitted version range; compatibility established from upstream release notes, the actual VUX source tree, and the platform adapter read at its pinned commit
pin_verification.artifact_download_rationale: downloading a gated package's wheel or sdist to hash it locally would sit on the wrong side of the gate's 'or otherwise using' clause; the PyPI-published sha256 is exactly what `pip --require-hashes` verifies at install time and what a pinned requirements file records. The consequence is disclosed honestly as D-S1 rather than papered over. Identical line to the accepted off-chain refreeze.

the proposed invocation targets a LOCAL DIRECTORY with --ignore-compile; it reads out/build-info/*.json from disk, constructs no Web3 provider, and makes no RPC call
slither/__main__.py — the module behind the `slither` console script — does not import web3 at the pinned commit; its imports are the standard library, crytic_compile, and slither internals
web3 is imported at slither/tools/read_storage/read_storage.py, which backs the SEPARATE slither-read-storage console script; that script is not invoked
the etherscan/address-target path in crytic_compile activates only when the target is a 0x… address; the target is `.`
unavoidable_in_family.proposed_mechanical_control: the CI step asserts no RPC endpoint is configured in the job environment, so a future edit that quietly adds one fails the gate rather than silently widening reachability
unavoidable_in_family.residual_stated_honestly: the package is PRESENT in the environment; the finding is unreachable on the invocation VUX runs, not absent
